payload.reason: The evidence provides specific directions for improving neural network language models, including architectural changes and techniques to enhance performance.

claims.text: Improvements can be made by implementing techniques such as importance sampling, word classes, caching, and bidirectional recurrent neural networks (BiRNN).
Increasing the model size and using special functions like encoding with a changeless neural network structure can enhance performance.
Exploring architectures like gate recurrent units (GRU) and dropout strategies can also contribute to improvements in neural network language models.
Repeating experiments on larger corpora may yield different results and insights for further improvements.
